# Third-Party Notices

This project, **OverPower**, uses third-party packages, libraries, and assets to enhance its capabilities, aesthetics, and development workflow. 

All integrated third-party resources retain their original copyright, license agreements, and End-User License Agreements (EULAs) set by their respective publishers or authors. The primary repository license does **not** apply to these third-party components.

## Overview of Licensing

1.  **Unity Asset Store Packages:**  
    Assets purchased or downloaded from the Unity Asset Store are subject to the [Unity Asset Store Terms of Service and EULA](https://unity.com/legal/as-terms). This typically grants a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the assets within the final compiled binary of the game, but does not allow redistribution of the source assets.
2.  **Open Source & Free Software:**  
    Libraries and tools released under open-source licenses (e.g., MIT, Apache 2.0) are governed by their respective license texts. Where required, the licenses and copyright notices for these open-source tools will be listed below.
